scope: Local Windows verification of working changes before commit. No tenant migration, production API behavior change, deployment or hosted CI run.
ciChanges: Backend tests compare full live Development document with snapshot; no export flag in CI
Frontend checks generated models before compiling consumers
Contract tools use an isolated locked package; audited and included in SBOM generation and Dependabot
limitations: Generated TypeScript does not validate untrusted runtime JSON, authorization or nonempty PATCH objects
BIGINT numeric range, trimming, timestamp/year checks and cross-field constraints remain server validation rules
No future workspace v2/expectedVersion behavior is implemented
Hosted CI, Docker/CodeQL execution and repository protection remain open SaaS-002 gates
Production browser suite not rerun: type-only frontend changes emit the identical previously verified bundle; backend integration suite was rerun
